title: Mind the Gap in Cultural Alignment: Task-Aware Culture Management for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (F1 scores) on culture-specific downstream NLP tasks (CultureLLM benchmark) and cultural knowledge true/false questions (CulturalBench) across diverse national cultures to measure the mitigation of Western-centric cultural bias.
Assessing the model's ability to identify bias by evaluating its F1 score on a gender bias detection downstream task specifically within the Chinese cultural context.
Assessing the model's ability to identify racism by evaluating its F1 score on a racism detection downstream task within the Bengali cultural context.
Assessing the model's ability to identify stereotypes by evaluating its F1 score on a stereotype detection downstream task within the Spanish cultural context.
